market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Bond selloff likely to continue (Dunn), Fed October hike priced in, oil volatility from Iran/Hormuz. Equities face headwind from rising yields but US-China truce and AI momentum provide support. Expect 2-4% equity volatility. Nasdaq may consolidate below record.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle broadening, US-China normalization, defense spending cycle, and crypto regulatory maturation support 6-12 month upside. However, sustained high rates and oil above $100 cap multiple expansion. Watch for Fed pivot signal by Q1 2027.
